messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nHandlers are being locked out of the claims-handling software when a required checkbox is not selected. This disruption to their workflow delays the processing of claims.\n\n## Who is affected\n- Handlers at Ashcombe Property Mutual are being locked out of the system [i:ee29a0a299a1566d].\n\n## Evidence\n- A customer reported that they have had handlers locked out already in a single week just from missing a checkbox [i:ee29a0a299a1566d].\n- This issue was reported via the support route [i:ee29a0a299a1566d].\n- There is 1 account, Ashcombe Property Mutual, with an ARR of £250,000 [i:ee29a0a299a1566d].\n- There has been 1 mention of this issue in total [i:ee29a0a299a1566d].\n- The issue was reported on 2026-10-25 [i:ee29a0a299a1566d].\n\n## Why now\n- The issue is actively disrupting workflows, as evidenced by lockouts occurring within a single week [i:ee29a0a299a1566d].\n- Ashcombe Property Mutual, the affected account, has a renewal date of 2026-11-30 [i:ee29a0a299a1566d].\n- There has been 1 renewal in the last 90 days [i:ee29a0a299a1566d].",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "ee29a0a299a1566d",
   "quote": "we’ve had two handlers locked out already this week just from missing a checkbox",
   "account": "Ashcombe Property Mutual",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-25T14:19:00+00:00"
  }
 ],
 "fact_sheet": {
  "as_of": "2026-11-03",
  "accounts_n": 1,
  "mentions_n": 1,
  "routes_n": 1,
  "mentions_by_route": {
   "support": 1
  },
  "arr_total_gbp": 250000.0,
  "renewals_90d_n": 1,
  "accounts": [
   {
    "name": "Ashcombe Property Mutual",
    "arr_gbp": 250000.0,
    "renewal_date": "2026-11-30",
    "mentions": 1
   }
  ]
 }
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The quote 'two handlers locked out already this week just from missing a checkbox' supports the lockout problem, the single-week timeframe, and the support route. Account name, ARR of £250,000, mention count of 1, report date 2026-10-25, renewal date 2026-11-30, and 1 renewal in the last 90 days all match the fact sheet exactly. The brief does not overstate scope (it correctly limits impact to one account) and no contrary evidence exists. All claims are cited to the single available insight.", "verdict": "pass"}
